name: Riser tensioners and motion compensators
description: Hydro-pneumatic tensioners and compensators keep a drilling or production riser under tension and decouple vessel heave from the riser. They are also used on top-tensioned production risers.

gaps.what: Tensioner stroke, tension capacity and redundancy
gaps.why: No page read gives tensioner stroke, capacity or the N+1 redundancy rule.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a tensioner datasheet or riser analysis and record stroke, capacity and redundancy
